purpose: Documentary identity record for the names La Capitana, Hualaca and Higuerón (Tumbes). Every statement rests on a verbatim quote from an official source archived in this PR with its real SHA-256. It does not create channels, catchments, outlets, receivers, events in any ledger, thresholds or map layers.

provenance.text_reading_method: pypdf text layer (PDF) or tag-stripped HTML, extracted from the archived bytes on the capture runner and stored in text/*.pages.json. No OCR, no LLM summarisation.
provenance.quote_rule: Each quote is a verbatim (whitespace-normalised) substring of the archived text page it cites; tests re-check this against files whose SHA-256 matches the manifest.
provenance.map_label_caveat: Map PDFs (ANA 2016) are read through their text layer. The order of labels in the extraction is not a spatial order: two labels printed next to each other in a quote need not be neighbours on the map.
provenance.independent_review: PENDING (ChatGPT scientific review). No quote has been re-read by a second reviewer yet.

identity_decisions.question: ¿Hualaca e Higuerón son quebradas diferentes, nombres alternativos del mismo cauce, o no se puede resolver?
identity_decisions.basis: Higuerón is named as a quebrada in three official sources archived here. Hualaca is named in none: 0 matches in every archived text, 0 results in the SIGRID library search, an empty INDECI media search, and no relevant web result. With no source naming Hualaca, no source can state that it is, or is not, the same channel as Higuerón.

identity_decisions.question: ¿Es 'Hualaca' una grafía de 'Hualtacal'?
identity_decisions.basis: The names look alike, but no source links them. Hualtacal is an attested official name (Ley 32573; ANA 2016 maps). It is recorded only so that the two labels are kept apart.

identity_decisions.question: ¿Higuerón y Hualtacal son el mismo cauce?
identity_decisions.basis: Ley 32573 §1.2 lists 'quebrada Higuerón y quebrada Hualtacal' as two items in one enumeration; ANA 2016 map 3743 prints 'Quebrada Higueron' and 'Quebrada Hualtacal' as separate labels. Distinct names, not a statement about drainage relation.

identity_decisions.question: ¿La Capitana e Higuerón son el mismo cauce?
identity_decisions.basis: INGEMMET A6764 Cuadro 3.2 gives them separate rows (C-27 quebrada La Capitana, C-28 quebrada Higuerón); ANA 2016 maps 3743 and 3755 print separate labels.

identity_decisions.question: ¿'La Capitana' es una quebrada o un centro poblado?
identity_decisions.basis: INGEMMET A6764 names the 'quebrada La Capitana'; ANA 2016 prints both 'Q Capitana' (quebrada label) and 'LA CAPITANA' (centro poblado label); INDECI 2024 and COEN 2025 name La Capitana / Capitana as a centro poblado / caserío. No source says the settlement lies on, or takes its name from, the quebrada.

identity_decisions.question: ¿'Higuerón' es una quebrada o un caserío/sector?
identity_decisions.basis: Quebrada Higuerón: INGEMMET A6764 C-28, Ley 32573, ANA 2016 maps. Settlement/sector Higuerón: road name 'Casa Blanqueada - Higuerón - Rica Playa', INGEMMET zones 2 and 8 ('Higuerón (San Jacinto)'), ANA 3743 centro poblado labels 'HIGUERON' and 'HIGUERON SECO', COEN 2025 'caseríos de Capitana e Higuerón'.

identity_decisions.question: ¿Las menciones de 'quebrada Higuerón' en Tumbes se refieren a un solo cauce?
identity_decisions.basis: Three contexts: (A) a road crossing on the PE-1N–San Pedro de los Incas–San Jacinto–Puente Francos road (INGEMMET C-28); (B) the Contralmirante Villar–Tumbes interprovincial divide (Ley 32573 §1.2), opposite the quebrada Tumbes; (C) ANA 2016 maps that print both 'Q. Higuerón' and 'Quebrada Higueron' on the same sheet (3743 and 3755). Text alone cannot tell whether these are one channel or several; the two spellings on one sheet are compatible with two features or with one feature labelled twice.

identity_decisions.question: ¿El 'sector Capitán Hoyle' del Reporte Complementario 13112 (San Jacinto, 27/9/2026) es La Capitana?
identity_decisions.basis: Different label in the source; no source relates them. RC 13112 and RC 13111 do not name La Capitana, Higuerón or Hualaca (absence of a name is not evidence that a quebrada was inactive).

identity_decisions.question: ¿Las quebradas El Higuerón de Piura, Cajamarca o La Libertad tienen relación con Tumbes?
identity_decisions.basis: ANA 2016 Piura map (Lalaquiz, San Miguel de El Faique) and SIGRID documents for Paimas (Piura), San Ignacio (Cajamarca) and Mocan/Casa Grande (La Libertad) use the same name in other departments. The capture logged the latter as CAPTURED_NOT_RETAINED_OUTSIDE_TUMBES_CONTEXT; none is attached to a Tumbes record.

statements.statement: INDECI (2024-02-20) lists La Capitana among six centros poblados that a Río Tumbes high flow measured at Cabo Inga 'podría afectar'. An exposure warning for the Río Tumbes, not an event of any quebrada.

COEN RC 3755 (2025-03-18) reports that on 17/3/2025 the Municipalidad Distrital de San Jacinto cleaned and rehabilitated roads in the caseríos Capitana and Higuerón. A response action, not an event of either quebrada.
ANA 2016 map 3743 prints the centro poblado label 'LA CAPITANA'.
Road name 'Casa Blanqueada - Higuerón - Rica Playa' (INGEMMET A6764).
ANA 2016 map 3743 centro poblado labels 'HIGUERON' and 'HIGUERON SECO'. Whether these are one or two settlements is not read.
COEN RC 3755: road works in the caseríos Capitana and Higuerón on 17/3/2025.
Ley 32573 lists 'quebrada Hualtacal' next to 'quebrada Higuerón' on the Contralmirante Villar–Tumbes divide.

Ley 32573 also states that the quebrada Seca 'aguas arriba cambia de nombre a quebrada Hualtacal' on the Canoas de Punta Sal / Casitas / Zorritos boundary. A reach-name change stated by the law for that quebrada Seca; whether it is the same Hualtacal as in §1.2 is not stated.
ANA 2016 maps 3743, 3755, 3761 (Cancas) and 3762 (Canoas de Punta Sal) print 'Hualtacal' labels.

national_inventory_crosswalk.integration: DEFERRED_UNTIL_INDEPENDENT_QA. The audit JSON and its generated Markdown are not edited in this PR. After review, the two unit records above can become audit rows with state IDENTITY_ONLY (the 2017 rows carry no event date, so the audit's dated-event rule cannot raise them) and Hualaca can join requested_names_without_source.

blockers_requiring_external_action: Hualaca: the origin of the name is unknown; only the requester or a local source (Municipalidad Distrital de San Jacinto, ALA Tumbes, Gobierno Regional) can say where it comes from.

Higuerón: deciding whether the road crossing (INGEMMET C-28), the Ley 32573 divide and the two ANA map spellings are one channel needs georeferenced data: ANA hydrography or the Ley 32573 memoria with its cartography (IGN sheets 0863/0864), or a field check by ALA Tumbes.

Geometry and outlet for both quebradas: no archived source carries a channel line, catchment or outlet. ANA geoservers (geosnirh.ana.gob.pe) and repositorio.ana.gob.pe were unreachable from the runners in this lane.
Dated events: the only per-unit evidence (INGEMMET A6764, 2017) is period-level. A dated activation needs an INDECI/COEN, SINPAD or municipal report that names the quebrada.
forbidden_uses: No alias, merge or 'same channel' decision may be taken from this record beyond the identity_decisions listed.
No geometry, outlet, receiver, parent basin or footprint may be derived from map label order or from district names.
The 2017 road-damage rows are not dated events, not footprints and not discharge or capacity evidence.
Settlement exposure statements (INDECI 2024) are not quebrada events.
Missing names in COEN reports are not evidence of inactivity (UNKNOWN_NOT_LOW_RISK).
